name: plugin.openclaw_gateway
description: WebSocket JSON-RPC gateway bridge connecting Harness agents to OpenClaw control plane, session placement, and channel routing.

entrypoints.name: openclaw_gateway_connect
entrypoints.description: Connects to an OpenClaw Gateway instance over WebSocket and verifies pairing credentials.

parameters.name: gateway_url
parameters.description: WebSocket endpoint URL for OpenClaw Gateway (e.g. ws://127.0.0.1:18789)

entrypoints.name: openclaw_gateway_list_sessions
entrypoints.description: Lists active session trees and status from the OpenClaw Gateway session catalog.

entrypoints.name: openclaw_gateway_create_session
entrypoints.description: Creates a new session placement on OpenClaw Gateway with specified channel and permission mode.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Target channel name (cli, slack, telegram, discord, web, a2a)

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Optional metadata dictionary to attach to session

entrypoints.name: openclaw_gateway_call_tool
entrypoints.description: Dispatches a tool execution request through the OpenClaw Gateway runtime.

parameters.name: tool_name
parameters.description: Name of the tool to execute on the gateway

entrypoints.name: openclaw_gateway_send_message
entrypoints.description: Routes a message to external messaging channels (Slack, Discord, Telegram, etc.) via OpenClaw Gateway.

parameters.name: recipient_id
parameters.description: Optional specific user or channel identifier
